title: CoverStory Phase 1 Days 001–010 instructor readiness
readiness_basis: Instructor harness executability, deterministic synthetic inputs, positive/negative controls, and declared module wiring only. Learner completion and unmeasured task duration do not gate this status.

days.title: Day 001 · 14 Oct 2026 — Preserve health shortlist order + source citations (150m)
days.reset_and_isolation: Read-only fixed synthetic JSON; Python HTTP harness loads the checked-in fixture per process; no shared mutable database.
positive_controls: first-seen composite selection order
synthetic catalog through CatalogPort -> adapter -> live Spring HTTP
CAP-41 exact citation transport with fixed documents
negative_controls: version-only and sorted-order defects
public endpoint safe 501 at learner TODO
anonymous session/import private routes fail closed
CAP-41 missing/foreign citation and TODO-safe HTTP 501
days.module_wiring: Spring app startup, Catalog module, CAP-40 shortlist HTTP route and loopback CAP-41 service; React production build/security checks are run as shared setup checks.
remaining_requirements: Implement the two named learner seams; keep public synthetic scope and safe 501 behavior until implemented.
Learner duration remains unmeasured; this does not block instructor harness readiness.

days.title: Day 002 · 15 Oct 2026 — Reconcile catalog evidence totals + Java identity (150m)
days.reset_and_isolation: Every PostgreSQL instructor test starts and closes a fresh embedded PostgreSQL instance; JSON fixture is read-only.
positive_controls: exact numeric control total and half-open UTC window
Catalog service/port bean graph starts and reaches CAP-43's explicit TODO
sequential exact editor/source/version/hash reference
negative_controls: wrong editor, inclusive upper bound, invalid currency
version-only key and whitespace-trimmed opaque hash mutants
real app does not claim a completed import
days.module_wiring: CAP-42 use case delegates through the Catalog evidence port; CAP-43 service resolves the Catalog-owned learner port in the actual Spring context.
remaining_requirements: Implement saved SQL/map policy only; persistent import storage, authenticated publishing and concurrent idempotency remain later product work.
Learner duration remains unmeasured and does not block scaffold readiness.

days.title: Day 003 · 16 Oct 2026 — Rank applicable wording + reconcile import attempts (150m)
days.reset_and_isolation: CAP-45 creates a new embedded PostgreSQL schema/fixture per test; CAP-44 reads immutable synthetic public/restricted rows.
positive_controls: category/scenario/visibility-constrained stable ranking
left-join evidence rows preserve nulls, attempts and exact source count
negative_controls: visibility/category/order/duplicate-token ranking mutants
inner join, source-only owner join and attempt fanout SQL mutants
days.module_wiring: CAP-44 is a bounded pure Python function seam; CAP-45 test-only SQL adapter executes against real embedded PostgreSQL 14. No external retrieval provider.

previously_recorded_acceptance.observed_behavior: Empty shape-only query returns no evidence rows; each learner assertion fails on its expected evidence output.

remaining_requirements: Implement the two saved learner seams; no product import ledger/provider is implied.
Learner duration remains unmeasured and does not block scaffold readiness.

days.title: Day 004 · 17 Oct 2026 — Bound catalog review queue + citation evaluation (150m)
days.reset_and_isolation: Each oracle replay constructs fresh in-memory queue/evaluation state from immutable fixtures.
positive_controls: bounded FIFO operations, empty poll and pending-only uniqueness
exact source/version support and correct abstention metrics
negative_controls: capacity overflow, LIFO ordering and permanent-duplicate mutants
presence-only, foreign citation, invalid answer map and abstention-with-citation mutants
days.module_wiring: Typed Catalog SourceVersionKey and CAP-46 TODO seam are compiled/discoverable; evaluation component is isolated Python fixture code. No broker or model is started.
remaining_requirements: Implement only the saved queue and evaluation seams; a real message broker and factual evaluation are outside these contracts.
Learner duration remains unmeasured and does not block scaffold readiness.

days.title: Day 005 · 18 Oct 2026 — Bucket source evidence by UTC day (150m)
days.reset_and_isolation: Fresh embedded PostgreSQL schema and fixed UTC rows for each test; classifier fixture is read-only.
positive_controls: explicit UTC date spine under UTC and Asia/Kolkata session zones
failure taxonomy precedence for correct abstention and citation errors
negative_controls: observed-only dates, local timestamp cast, wrong owner
unsupported-answer, source/version precedence and false-abstention controls
days.module_wiring: CAP-48 SQL is exercised through test-only JDBC against embedded PostgreSQL; CAP-49 is a pure Python classification seam.
remaining_requirements: Implement only saved SQL/classifier seams; no live wording or provider source is connected.
Learner duration remains unmeasured and does not block scaffold readiness.

days.title: Day 006 · 19 Oct 2026 — Count import decisions + test Spring seam (150m)
days.reset_and_isolation: Fresh fake identity map per CAP-50 oracle; fresh embedded PostgreSQL schema/fixtures per CAP-51 test.
positive_controls: ACCEPT counted once through test-only Catalog service fake
EXISTS-style confirmed-attempt totals for own fixture owner
negative_controls: same-hash duplicate, changed-hash conflict and foreign-editor scope
raw join fanout and source-only cross-editor attempt mutants
days.module_wiring: CAP-50 service/fake lives behind Catalog-owned ports; CAP-51 SQL is a test-only adapter on PostgreSQL. No durable production import repository.
remaining_requirements: Implement saved learner methods; persistent identity/retries and transaction guarantees remain unclaimed.
Learner duration remains unmeasured and does not block scaffold readiness.

days.title: Day 007 · 20 Oct 2026 — Define collision-safe catalog version identity (150m)
days.reset_and_isolation: Fresh pure-value vectors are read from immutable JSON; no database or process state persists.
positive_controls: exact source/version pair key creates a typed identity
negative_controls: delimiter-concatenation collision and null/blank components
days.module_wiring: Catalog-owned SourceVersionKey is the module value type; CAP165Seam remains the learner-owned factory TODO.
remaining_requirements: Implement and use the saved key factory; no persistence is in this day's contract.
Learner duration remains unmeasured and does not block scaffold readiness.

days.title: Day 008 · 21 Oct 2026 — Expose tested catalog import API (150m)
days.reset_and_isolation: Each MockMvc request uses fresh in-memory decision fake/counters; actual Spring check uses a fresh random-port application context.
positive_controls: trusted test principal reaches the injected fake decision port once
route is registered in the actual application context
negative_controls: anonymous/applicant denied, spoofed owner and malformed hash rejected before seam
actual route returns 401 without the trusted-principal adapter
days.module_wiring: Spring controller is component-scanned and tested; trusted identity adapter and durable decision persistence remain explicitly absent.
remaining_requirements: Implement saved decision seam; production authentication and durable idempotency are not supplied by this day.
Learner duration remains unmeasured and does not block scaffold readiness.

days.title: Day 009 · 22 Oct 2026 — Load synthetic product wording safely (150m)
days.reset_and_isolation: Immutable checked-in corpus plus TemporaryDirectory cases; every oracle invocation rebuilds its state and does not call the learner loader.
positive_controls: allowlisted filename ordering, exact source/version labels and repeatable corpus read
unlisted file ignored
negative_controls: path traversal rejected before outside read, duplicate file/source-version, restricted content and atomic rejection
days.module_wiring: Typed PublicWording/LoadError seam and acceptance tests compile; test-only reference loader does not implement the learner function.
remaining_requirements: Implement allowlisted local-file loading; no online/provider import is in scope.
Learner duration remains unmeasured and does not block scaffold readiness.

days.title: Day 010 · 23 Oct 2026 — Authorize UUID journey and homepage resume (150m)
days.reset_and_isolation: Test-only fixture port graph is reconstructed per test from immutable synthetic owner/revision rows.
positive_controls: owner-bound lookup and exact authoritative application revision
safe status/action summaries and bounded owner listing
negative_controls: foreign and absent UUID produce same safe 404 before application read
UUID-only access, private-field output, oversized page and foreign cursor
days.module_wiring: Actual Spring /api/session and /api/v1/me/journeys routes resolve only a trusted request principal. Application-owned JDBC reads join the owner-scoped journey to the exact linked application revision. A test-only synthetic session and independent PostgreSQL adapter exercise the actual HTTP/browser path; production auth binding and the saved CAP54Seam remain learner work and fail closed.
remaining_requirements: Bind the trusted servlet principal to the deployment's authenticated session adapter; no login provider or real credential flow is included. Implement the CAP54Seam learner methods; the configured application route returns safe 501 until they are complete. Learner duration remains unmeasured.
